verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe a human-in-the-loop pattern: when a tool call requires approval, the SDK pauses the run, returns interruptions, and lets you resume later from the same RunState—directly matching the pause/resume-with-human-decision story. This is documented for the JS SDK's human-in-the-loop guide; missing for 10: explicit Python SDK parity documentation and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
